## Description

Please provide a clear and concise summary of the changes proposed in this Pull Request.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat:` A new feature or endpoint method
- [ ] `fix:` A bug fix
- [ ] `docs:` Documentation updates
- [ ] `refactor:` Code refactoring (no functional changes)
- [ ] `test:` Adding or updating unit tests
- [ ] `build:` / `ci:` Build configuration or CI/CD updates
- [ ] `chore:` Miscellaneous maintenance tasks

## Checklist

- [ ] My PR title adheres to [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (e.g. `feat(resumes): add custom print options`).
- [ ] I have verified that no runtime dependencies were introduced (`dependencies` remains empty).
- [ ] I have run `npm run typecheck` and verified strict TypeScript compilation.
- [ ] I have added unit tests in `tests/` for my changes and all tests pass (`npm test`).
- [ ] If applicable, I verified that the interactive demo builds (`npm run build:demo`).
- [ ] I have updated corresponding documentation in `README.md` if public API surfaces changed.
